policy.P0_evaluation_human_review: All validation and test records require real human approval before release.
policy.P1_training_provenance_review: Review missing, mismatched, or fuzzy-rebound corpus evidence before training.
policy.P2_training_semantic_review: Review transformed tasks, global claims, aggregation claims, and grammar.
policy.clean_training_candidate: No automatic repair flag; still a candidate rather than a human-approved fact.
